title: Scheduled Water Interruption
body: Water supply will be interrupted tomorrow, March 7 from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM for routine maintenance of the main supply line. Please store water in advance.
author: Facilities Team

title: Electric Meter Maintenance
body: Technicians will conduct scheduled electric meter inspection and maintenance on March 10, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Brief power interruptions may occur per floor.
author: Facilities Team

title: New Utility Rates Effective April 2026
body: Please be informed that new utility billing rates will take effect starting April 1, 2026. Electricity rate increases to ₱11.50/kWh. Review the updated rate schedule in Settings.
author: Billing Department

title: Billing Portal Downtime
body: The billing portal will undergo scheduled maintenance on March 8 from 12:00 MN to 3:00 AM. Online bill payments will be temporarily unavailable during this period.
author: IT Department
